messages:
Maya: hi everyone, Maya here (day 1). Running the dotfiles bootstrap on an M1 Mac with zsh + direnv. asdf install for python 3.11 and node 18 keeps failing with missing openssl headers. Followed the README but something's off. Anyone have a small checklist for apple silicon + direnv quirks?

quentin: welcome Maya! :wave: Quick checklist I use: 1) Ensure Homebrew is ARM: /opt/homebrew. 2) brew install openssl@1.1 readline pkg-config gpg libffi. 3) Add brew to your shell: `eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"` in ~/.zprofile.

irene: since you use direnv, note direnv loads after shell init; make sure build env vars are set in your interactive shell config (e.g., ~/.zshrc) so asdf sees them during compile. I put a `source ~/.shell_env` line in my ~/.zshrc that dotfiles bootstrap writes.

Maya: what exactly should be in ~/.shell_env?

quentin: we keep these minimal: `export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"` `export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include"` `export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/pkgconfig"` and `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"`. Source that before `asdf install`.

Maya: node plugin asked me to import gpg keys and failed with pinentry. Any one-off fix?

irene: `brew install gpg pinentry-mac` then `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` and run `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring`. If pinentry misbehaves, `gpgconf --kill gpg-agent && gpgconf --launch gpg-agent` usually clears it.

Maya: dotfiles bootstrap created a .envrc stub and direnv blocked it. Should I fill secrets there?

dotfiles-bot: note: bootstrap intentionally writes .envrc.example and a .envrc.stub. Do NOT commit secrets. Use 1Password CLI helpers included in dotfiles to populate local .envrc from secure items.

Maya: how do folks handle 1Password CLI auth with direnv? I don't want session expiry to break direnv loads.

quentin: we run `op signin --raw` and export the session token into a session file that direnv reads. dotfiles include `scripts/op-load.sh` which writes ephemeral envvars; it prompts for re-auth when needed. If you prefer interactive, sign in in a terminal and export `OP_SESSION_<account>` in ~/.shell_env temporarily.

Maya: SSH key & GitHub flow: added my key but repo access says pending. Any special infra step?

infra-bot: created ticket ONB-908 for Maya. Infra auto-sync runs every 15-30 min after key is added to GitHub. If you need faster access ping @quentin for escalation.

irene: quick zsh tip: if asdf still picks up old envs, open a clean login shell (`zsh -l`) after bootstrap so ~/.zprofile runs and path changes propagate. Also run `asdf plugin-list` to confirm plugin locations are under ~/.asdf/plugins.

Maya: this is great, thanks all. I'll source ~/.shell_env and try again, will ping if node/python still choke. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
